Nora (AE): SeafordBank returned the SIG; they specifically called out key rotation, pen-test windows, and evidence format. Can we split Q owners and confirm delivery timeline?

Dev (Solutions Eng): I'll take key rotation (Q14) and SSO mapping. Will attach rotation policy + sample API call. ETA tomorrow AM.

Raj (Security): I'll own pen-test / vuln mgmt (Q41/Q56) and logging retention. Note: for Private we provide templates; actual scans are customer-run unless PS purchased.

Aileen (Sales Eng): Procurement wants a one-liner about HSM support for the RFI: short, clear, and with PS note.

Procurement (SeafordBank): Also need confirmation that at-rest encryption uses AES-256-GCM and whether master key rotation can be customer-controlled.

Dev (Solutions Eng): Confirm AES-256-GCM. Master key rotation: customer-controlled in Private via KMS API. Sample rotate call: `POST /kms/keys/<id>/rotate {"period":90}`. Will add to Q14 cell.

Raj (Security): Pen-test windows: we can support coordinated tests. For Hosted we run annual third-party pentests; for Private we provide an ops POC and a coordination SOW. I'll draft Q88 reply.

EvidenceBot: File uploaded: "SOC2-summary-2025.pdf" -> https://files.redwood/sales/1765432100/SOC2-summary-2025.pdf

Aileen (Sales Eng): Suggested RFI line: "Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; BYOHSM integrations available via Professional Services (estimated 3-6 weeks)." Good?

Procurement (SeafordBank): Yes, that works. Please add a ballpark cost range in the SOW later.

Dev (Solutions Eng): I'll create the SIG spreadsheet with columns: qid, short_answer, artifact_name, link, owner. Uploading link in a bit.

Raj (Security): Reminder to redact IPs/hostnames in any scan PDFs. I'll do a scrub pass before we share.

Nora (AE): Owners recap: Dev -> Q14 + sheet; Raj -> Q41/Q56/Q88 + scans; Aileen -> RFI line + packaging; Nora -> final email to Seaford legal. Deliver by EOD tomorrow?

Dev (Solutions Eng): Yep, aiming for EOD.

Aileen (Sales Eng): I'll prepare the 1-pager and include the PS estimate placeholder.

Procurement (SeafordBank): Appreciate it — will review once the pack lands.

EvidenceBot: Evidence bundle scheduled: https://files.redwood/sales/1765432100/package.zip (generated at 1765432600)

Nora (AE): Thanks everyone. Ping me if blocked. :pray:
